svg.title: Hyouga Yui — Nine Hells Frozen. Draft 2 / Ice classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Permafrost Heart forks into Weight of the Avalanche then Buried in the Avalanche, or Deepening Frost then The Glacier Advances. Cocytus Vigil forks into Cracks in the Ice then Nine Hells Opened, or Rime Mantle then Locked in Cocytus. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Ice-classified Hyouga Yui jutsu.

The Ground Control trait lives in Glacial Descent: Cocytus (35% exposure and 35% guard on one 40 AP cast), Nine Hell's Spear's 35% circle exposure and Glacier's Will's 30% ground guard, so Increase Damage Taken and Decrease Damage Taken form the secondary. Increase Damage Given sits on two 35% self rows (Avalanche, Glacier's Will) beside a bloodline passive of the same tag. All three percentage ladders stop at +7 on two rows, so below Damage the tiers are co-equal in size: control ranks above IDG because it spans two tags and its exposure lifts allies' hits, while IDG serves the caster alone; trimming IDG to +6 so the order is arithmetic is a user-owned option (design notes). Cocytus"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":null,"design_notes":["Node split: Permafrost Heart (+3 self Increase Damage Given) forks into a Damage route (Weight of the Avalanche \u2192 Buried in the Avalanche) and an amplifier route (Deepening Frost \u2192 The Glacier Advances). Cocytus Vigil (+2 exposure, +2 guard) forks into exposure (Cracks in the Ice \u2192 Nine Hells Opened) and guard (Rime Mantle \u2192 Locked in Cocytus). Taiyo Kami's 2/4/4 fork and +2/+3 Damage route are reused; the IDG-only root and +2/+2 capstones depart because each percentage tag reaches two rows.","Calibration by coverage: Damage +2/+3 (max +5 on three rows). Each percentage tag reaches two rows, so each ladder stops at +7: IDG 3/2/2, IDT 2/3/2, DDT 2/3/2 (42% on the 35% rows, 37% on Glacier's Will's 30%). Row-weighted: Foundations 6/8, Hidden Arts 4\u20136, Advanced Arts 8\u201310; full builds 24\u201330 (Taiyo 16\u201331; the higher floor follows from every percentage tag covering two rows). Deepening Frost (+2 on two rows, 4) is deliberately the thin step and exists chiefly as the amplifier route's gate.","Why a single-tag root: the self side carries only IDG (Avalanche, Glacier's Will) and DDT (Cocytus, Glacier's Will). DDT in both roots would let guard reach +9 on two rows at 4 BP, and IDT in both would do the same for exposure, so Permafrost Heart takes IDG alone at +3 and the Cocytus root owns both control tags. The IDG route reaches +5 at 2 BP and +7 at 3 BP; any two Advanced Arts cost 5 or 6 BP.","Resolver (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73, \u00a73b): Avalanche's IDG row (Ice/None/Water/Wind) adds to Ice, Water, Wind and element-less hits; Glacier's Will's IDG and both DDT rows (four stat types, no element) act on every non-pierce hit given or taken, as does Spear's exposure; Cocytus's (Highest, no element) covers element-less hits plus elemental hits of the caster's highest offence stat. Kit rows add power/100 \u00d7 staged base and sum when live; only the passive multiplies. IDG, IDT and DDT skip pierce.","Delivery: all cooldown 7. Strikes: 60 AP, range 4, radius-1 circle on an OTHER_USER target, friendly fire ENEMIES. Cocytus: 40 AP, OPPONENT, IDT on the target, DDT on the caster. Glacier's Will: 40 AP, EMPTY_GROUND, range 5; IDG row SELF; DDT row an INHERIT FRIENDLY ground circle re-applied each round to caster and allies on the tiles; move row sorts last (\u00a74b). Buff/debuff rows are live in the two rounds after the cast round, never in it (\u00a73b), so no strike takes its own jutsu's buff.","Fourth purchases: Burst takes Cocytus Vigil or Deepening Frost; Amplifier, Cocytus Vigil or Weight of the Avalanche; Exposure, Permafrost Heart or Rime Mantle; Lake warden, Cracks in the Ice or Permafrost Heart. 13 of 14 full builds are non-dominated; strongest 06,07,08,09 (30). User-owned value options: IDG 3/2/1 (max +6, tier order arithmetic); IDG 2/3/2 (Deepening Frost 6, Permafrost Heart 4); Nine Hells Opened +1 power, not +2 (14 of 14 non-dominated, full builds 24\u201329)."],"risks":["Classification: Ice is not exclusive. Blue Blade Eyes and Teno Yuki (INCLUDE), Blue Edge Eyes (EXCLUDE) and five DEFER records carry Ice rows; the normal-jutsu collision is unverified. Today 4 of 9 supported rows match Ice directly and 5 fall back to None, which reaches non-elemental rows on any jutsu. The tree assumes a bloodline-scoped classification and is inert or leaky without it.","IDG stacking: both 35% self rows reach 42%. Avalanche (60 AP) and Glacier's Will (40 AP) fit one 100 AP turn (ENGINE_LAWS 61), so both are live for the same two rounds and add 84% of the staged base on hits matching both (\u00a73b) before the 25% + 0.15/level passive multiplies. Glacier's Will's row also reaches basic attacks, weapons and normal jutsu. Not simulated; normal-tree potency unapproved.","Exposure leakage: Spear's exposure (no element) raises every non-pierce hit from the caster, allies and weapons on every enemy in its circle; Cocytus's (Highest, no element) raises element-less hits and elemental hits of the caster's highest offence stat on one target. Spear and Cocytus fit one turn (60 + 40 AP), so one enemy can carry 84% for two rounds. Pierce hits take no exposure or guard.","Guard scale: Cocytus's 35% self guard and Glacier's Will's 30% ground guard reach 42% and 37%; both fit one turn (40 + 40 AP), so a caster on the circle can hold 79% on non-pierce hits while both are live; the ladder stops at +7. The ground guard is positional and covers allies on the tiles; its FRIENDLY re-application and first active round follow the dossier and \u00a74b, not a process.ts read.","Ally hazard: none on supported rows. All three Damage rows and Spear's exposure are friendly fire ENEMIES; Cocytus is an OPPONENT-target single cast; Glacier's Will's supported rows are SELF or FRIENDLY. The kit's only ally-hazard row is Spear's wound (friendly fire none) and its only enemy-hazard row is Glacier's Will's move; both are unsupported and unchanged.","Dominated allocation: 01,02,06,07 (power +2, self buff +3, exposure +5, guard +2) is dominated by 01,06,07,08, because Nine Hells Opened carries the same +2 power as Weight of the Avalanche; a player wanting both Hidden Arts' effects should buy the exposure capstone instead. Every node still appears in a non-dominated full build; 13 of 14 are non-dominated.","Delivery: three 60 AP strikes and two 40 AP supports, all cooldown 7, so a route's full value is realized over a seven-round cycle and the ladders pay only inside 2-round windows. Glacial Shatter: Purgatory is a D-rank record with the same 45 power as the A-rank Spear, so the +5 power route raises it equally. No injected children, item gates, hidden jutsu or mode restrictions exist.","Context: skill-tree and bloodline effects are suppressed in ranked PvP and sparring. The 15% Wind Decrease Damage Taken passive is a bloodline effect and is untouched. The IDG passive is 25% + 0.15/level (28.75% if scaled at level 25; level basis unverified). The tree equalises marginal opportunity against the reference, not final strength. No combat simulation; balance values remain user-owned."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":10,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":4,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":10,"4":14},"full_budget_allocations":14,"non_dominated_full_allocations":13,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":7,"increasedamagetaken":7,"decreasedamagetaken":7},"supported_rows_in_kit":9,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":3,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 2 / Ice classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; g.text: Draft 2 / Ice classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Hyouga Yui jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Descent Cocytus · Will · Hell's Spear (4 effects)
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Buried in the Avalanche path + Cocytus Vigil
The Glacier Advances path + Cocytus Vigil
Nine Hells Opened path + Permafrost Heart
Locked in Cocytus path + Cracks in the Ice
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
